description: An annular inflammatory skin eruption characterised by expanding rings or arcs.
causes: The exact cause is often not identified; some cases are associated with an underlying trigger or condition

appearance.general: Annular or polycyclic erythematous lesions that expand centrifugally, sometimes with a trailing scale.

doctor_discussion_points: Discuss recent infections, medicines, and any associated systemic symptoms if the eruption persists.
